note: Rules a JSON Schema cannot express. The validator's RULES table must list exactly these ids with these severities (verify_all.py checks it).

rules.rule: A PageSpec's nodes must be exactly its declared template's node list in order: every required node present, optional nodes only where the template lists them, no others.
The route must match the template's routePattern; the home template only on '/'.
shell.navbar is the first node on every template.
shell.footer-contact, when present, is the last node.
At most one HERO node. Exceptions: about, project-detail and not-found have no HERO at all (none required).
hero.intro and content.intro-note appear only on the home template.
The same section id never appears twice in a row (no template repeats a section).
Sections with retrievalEligible=false (runtime UI) are never nodes; they may only be listed in runtimeLayers allowed by the template.
Every runtimeLayers entry must be allowed by the template.
A node's motion.pattern must be one of its section contract's patterns.
motion.reducedMotionFallback must equal the pinned fallback of the chosen pattern.
At most one WebGL scene pattern (gallery-strip-scroll, plane-focus-stage, floating-digits) per page; more is allowed but warned.
Every text field respects its section contract's maxWords budget.
An asset's role must be a generatedAssetRoles entry of its section in generated mode, or a reference/generated role of the section in reference mode.
Node token references must exist in the catalog, fit their slot, resolve in the page theme and never be raw values or restricted tokens.
Generated pages contain no source brand/wordmark/domain spelling.
Generated pages name no real person from the source (owner, credited developer, artists, contact email, age).
Generated pages reuse no real project title, client name or project id.
Generated pages reuse no source copy (5-word shingle overlap or equality with any registry string of 3+ words).
Generated pages reuse no source call-to-action / interaction label.
Generated pages link only to site-relative paths or reserved placeholder domains; no source domain, social profile, email or store link.
Generated pages use only generation-safe asset roles with placeholder://, generated:// or user-supplied:// sources and no source file names.
Generated pages never use the source wordmark/favicon roles.
Section contracts and the allowlist must agree with the retrieval pin in code: runtime UI is never retrievable, content sections always are.
assets/asset-roles.json availability must equal PINNED_AVAILABILITY in code; validation always uses the pinned value.
Reference pages may use reference-only/blocked roles only with site-relative source paths (evidence), never placeholder schemes for source roles.
